APIs for XDP networking, RX packet bounds checks, and topology link setup.

# Purpose
`fd_net_tile.h` declares the interface for Firedancer `net` tile networking and topology setup. It defines the `fd_net_rx_bounds_t` helper used to validate and translate received packet fragments into local addresses, with [`fd_net_rx_bounds_init`](<#fd_net_rx_bounds_init>) and [`fd_net_rx_translate_frag`](<#fd_net_rx_translate_frag>) enforcing packet bounds and MTU limits. The file also declares topology functions that add `net` and `netlnk` tiles, create RX links from `net` to application tiles, register TX links into `net`, and finish `net` tile setup after all links are created.
# Function Declarations (Public API)

---
- `fd_topos_net_tiles`
- `fd_topos_net_rx_link`
- `fd_topos_tile_in_net`
- `fd_topos_net_tile_finish`
